title: Lithuania Faces Twin Pressures of Surging Inflation and a Battle Over Public… · 12 Sep
keywords: Lithuania, inflation, cost of living, HICP, eurozone, LRT, public broadcaster, media independence, rule of law, European Commission, Baltic states, energy prices, fiscal policy, democratic standards, governance
notes: Lithuania is confronting two serious challenges simultaneously: an inflation rate nearly double the eurozone average and a politically charged dispute over the governance of its public broadcaster, LRT. Both issues are testing the government's credibility and raising broader questions about living standards and democratic standards in the Baltic state. The tensions come at a moment when public anxiety is running high and institutional trust is fragile.
